prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1121; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Can you state where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on Broadway in Pearland, heading east toward the main intersection near the shopping center.

Q: What were the weather and road conditions like at that time?

A: It was clear and dry. Traffic was moderate, nothing unusual for that stretch.

Q: Tell me what happened leading up to the impact.

A: I had slowed down because the light ahead turned yellow and the cars in front of me were stopping. I came to a complete stop behind a white sedan. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind.

Q: Did you see the vehicle that hit you before the impact?

A: No, I didn't see it. I was looking forward at the traffic signal. I only heard tires and then the impact.

Q: Were you able to get out of your vehicle after the collision?

A: Yes, but I was sore right away. My right shoulder hurt badly, and I had trouble lifting my arm. I sat on the curb until the ambulance arrived.

Q: Have you received any medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I was taken to the emergency room and they took X-rays. The doctor said I had a strained shoulder and prescribed physical therapy. I've been going to sessions twice a week.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?

A: Only that I was wearing my seatbelt and my car was stopped completely when I was hit. I want to make sure my side of things is recorded accurately.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
